It groups `NEWS` as a generic post and does not explain RSS-fed news content or SHARE of peer-shared news; READ uses content-recommender shortlist plus random item selection and reactions, COMMENT/REPLY/SEARCH have distinct recommender constraints, and FOLLOW is a separate score-weighted probabilistic tie action rather than a generic suggestion. Core profile dimensions (languages, political leaning, topics, model identity, and Big Five) are mostly hidden under `Profile`; only the five dichotomous traits are named. Those API/action distinctions and profile-conditioned behaviors are the described contribution, so the current extraction is too generic for an independent, source-complete model summary.
